maya: Quick poll — looking for a tight noir mini or short film + score to watch tonight. Under 2.5 hrs total. Rainy-night mood, low dialogue.
sam: The short 'Pickup' on Vimeo — ~30m — moody synth + sax. link: https://vimeo.com/12345678
devin: If you want series vibes: watch 'Top of the Lake' ep1 + then loop a couple of ambient jazz cues. Total ~1h40m, heavy but atmospheric.
jana: For something really short and weird: 'The Red Balloon' isn't noir but it's oddly haunting. Pair with Miles Davis (Kind of Blue) at low volume :film_projector:
brandon: Vote: 1) Pickup (Vimeo) 2) Top of the Lake ep1 3) Red Balloon + Miles. React with :one:/:two:/:three:
maya: Also — snack recs? tea vs whiskey debate.
sam: Whiskey for me :whiskey: — lemon peel, one big ice cube.
devin: Tea — strong black with honey. Also made a tiny playlist of noir-ish cues if anyone wants it: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0abcDEF
jana: Brandon can you paste the playlist id? mobile's blocked for me.
brandon: playlist id: 0abcDEF — has 'Noir City' mixes and 'Shadow Theme' by J. Kline. Short, good for background.
ops-bot: Reminder: office projector reserved 20:00-22:00 in #lounge for tonight. :white_check_mark:
maya: Sweet. I'll grab HDMI and bring tea + biscotti. See you at 8. :thumbsup:
